segs.t: Well guys, it looks like Shopify is down again and it looks like a routine that Shopify is starting to implement every single month
But they go down for an hour or two, but guess who's taking the hit? Us merchants
We're the ones not making money right now
If Facebook ends up going offline or even ends up overspending in a single day, it just blows through 20 to 30k
Well, you need to get used to it and I think what you need to also understand is that most of you are probably thinking
Ah, should I turn off my ads right now?
It's a store cannot generate any money. I'm not even stressed about that
I leave my ads running, I go outside touch grass and after two hours Shopify is back up and running
Orders are coming in again, and I just ride through the wave. You need to get used to it. It's all part of the game
